title: AEB 独立 control 通道
scope: real_zmq_loopback: real pyzmq ROUTER bound on an ephemeral port and a real DEALER peer with an explicit IDENTITY. No model or device involved.

environment.host_version: AstrBot 4.26.7 present at D:/Code/AstrBot-latest (read-only, not on PYTHONPATH)

interfaces.start() / close(): repeatable; close cancels pending waits, releases the socket and frees the port
interfaces.capabilities(peer, *, refresh, timeout_s: upper.capabilities.get; cached per peer+ex_session with a 30 s TTL; ControlError on timeout/unsupported/stale
interfaces.resolve_peer(peer): explicit trusted peer only; default_peer is never consulted
interfaces.DeliveryOutcome.to_dict(): status, batch_id, request_id, payload_hash, error_code, sent, duplicate, detail; contains no segment text
